Inventory Management and Product Returns We have an extended design and manufacturing process, which involves product designs, the purchase of raw and other materials, inventory accumulation, the subsequent sale of finished product, and the collection of resulting accounts receivable. This production cycle results in significant liquidity requirements and working capital fluctuations throughout our fiscal year. Because the cycle typically involves long lead times, which requires us to make manufacturing decisions several months in advance of anticipated customer demand, it is challenging for us to accurately estimate and manage our inventory and working capital requirements.
